name: porkbun-cli
description: Agent-friendly CLI for the Porkbun API v3.
author: Jose Mocito

scripts.postbuild: mkdir -p dist/generated && cp src/generated/openapi.json dist/generated/openapi.json && chmod +x dist/cli.js
scripts.validate: pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm audit
scripts.security:scripts: command -v shellcheck >/dev/null && shellcheck $(find . -type f -name '*.sh' -not -path './node_modules/*' -not -path './.git/*') || echo 'shellcheck not installed; skipping'
scripts.security:workflows: command -v actionlint >/dev/null && actionlint .github/workflows/*.yml || echo 'actionlint not installed; skipping'
scripts.security:local: pnpm audit && pnpm security:secrets && pnpm security:scripts && pnpm security:workflows
